files_summary.contacts.json: Array of contact profiles (contact_id, name, email, phone, department_id).
files_summary.messages.csv: CSV of messages (message_id, from_contact_id, to_contact_id, timestamp, body).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: contacts_get
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a single contact by contact_id and returns the contact record when it exists, otherwise indicates it was not found. Refuses requests that omit contact_id or provide an invalid/empty identifier. Refuses lookups for contact_id values that do not correspond to any contact in the directory.

tool_schemas.name: contacts_search
tool_schemas.description: Searches the directory for contacts whose name or email contains the provided query substring (case-insensitive) and returns the matching contacts. Refuses requests with a missing, empty, or non-string query. Refuses queries that are too vague to evaluate (for example, whitespace-only input) and reports that the search term is invalid.

tool_schemas.name: contacts_send_message
tool_schemas.description: Queues a simulated message addressed to the specified contact and returns the queued message envelope. Refuses requests missing contact_id or body, or where either value is empty or not a string. Refuses sending when the recipient contact_id does not exist in the directory, because it cannot deliver to an unknown contact.

tool_schemas.name: list_departments
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full list of department objects in the directory. Refuses requests that include unsupported parameters, since this endpoint does not accept filters or pagination. Refuses access when department listings are not available in the current service state.

tool_schemas.name: get_message_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns message history, either all messages or only those involving the specified contact_id as sender or recipient. Refuses requests where contact_id is provided but is empty or not a valid identifier. Refuses filtered requests for a contact_id that does not exist, because there is no history to associate with an unknown contact.

contact_id.description: Optional contact id to filter messages sent to or from.

metadata.name: Orchard Contact Exchange
metadata.description: A lightweight organizational directory that lets users search contacts by department and send messages while tracking conversation history.
